note.windows: The whole setup takes about 10 minutes and 1 GB. Python, MSYS2 (for the OpenNap test server) and the Visual Studio Build Tools are installed if they are missing; the Build Tools are about 3 GB and add 15 to 30 minutes. Point it at napv2b10-3.exe (Napster 2.0 beta 10.3; it is unpacked, never run). A 2001 network client: it is set up to talk to a local OpenNap server on 127.0.0.1 only. Read SECURITY.md.
